summary: Offline zombie sniper FPS, survive the apocalypse against the dead & epic bosses
description:
Zombie Sniper War 3

Zombie Sniper War 3 is an offline first-person shooter where you battle through a post-apocalyptic world overrun by the undead. Complete story missions, upgrade a powerful arsenal of weapons, defeat epic bosses, and uncover the mystery behind the outbreak. Every mission brings you one step closer to humanity's survival.

★ Explore 9 Unique Regions

Travel through ruined cities, abandoned forests, military facilities, underground tunnels, deserts, and high-tech laboratories. Every region introduces new enemies, mission objectives, and a unique boss encounter.

★ Hundreds of Missions Across Six Game Modes

• Story Missions
• Sniper Missions
• Side Missions
• Defense Mode
• Contract Missions
• Lucy Story Missions

Experience both classic stationary sniper missions and free-movement combat. From long-range precision shooting to defending fortified positions against overwhelming enemy waves, every mission offers different objectives, challenges, and strategies.

★ Epic Boss Battles

Every region ends with an unforgettable boss fight. Face terrifying enemies including Bio-Mutants, Tunnel Dwellers, Cyborg Ninjas, Arachnid Queens, and many more. Learn their attack patterns, adapt your tactics, and fight for survival.

★ Weapons & Progression
Unlock and upgrade a huge collection of firearms, including:

• Sniper Rifles
• Assault Rifles
• SMGs
• LMGs
• Shotguns
• Sidearms

Upgrade every weapon, unlock Prestige, and continue improving your favorite firearms instead of leaving them behind as you progress through the game.

Customize your arsenal with unique weapon skins, including themed and seasonal designs.

★ Special Equipment
Bring advanced equipment into battle to gain the upper hand.

Use Grenades, Healing Packs, Thermal Vision, Focus Mode (Stimpack), Infinite Ammo Packs, Ion Strikes, and Missile Barrages to overcome the toughest encounters.

★ Character Progression

Collect helmets, tactical gear, and military equipment that provide unique gameplay bonuses. Complete armor sets to unlock additional upgrades, and discover seasonal gear during limited-time events.

★ VIP Benefits

VIP players can unlock a helper drone that automatically reloads weapons during combat, allowing them to stay focused on the action.

★ Key Features

• Offline gameplay — no internet connection required
• Play the complete campaign offline anytime, anywhere
• More than 700 missions
• Stationary and free-movement gameplay
• Nine unique regions with epic boss battles
• Story, Sniper, Side, Defense, Contract, and Lucy Missions
• Extensive arsenal of upgradeable firearms
• Prestige weapon progression
• Character progression with armor and gear
• Detailed 3D environments
• Smooth and responsive controls
• Weapon skins and seasonal equipment
• Daily Challenges and Achievements
• Seasonal events and regular content updates

★ Download Zombie Sniper War 3 and experience an offline first-person shooter featuring nine unique regions, deep weapon progression, challenging boss battles, and intense survival gameplay.
